title: Act: Implement the world repository and read handlers
description: Context: world data lives in worlds/<id>/world.yaml and rounds/<round>/round.yaml, game content in game/content/worlds/<id>. Desired behavior: a world repository and handlers for the four read endpoints. Expected result: JSON responses, 404 for unknown worlds. Why: the client needs world, game and round state.
acceptance_criteria: Given worlds/the-boys-room/world.yaml, when GET /api/v1/worlds runs, then a JSON array containing that world id is returned
Given an unknown or unsafe world id, when GET /api/v1/worlds/{id} runs, then 404 is returned
Given round directories, when GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current runs, then the highest-numbered round with id, number, status, starts_at and ends_at is returned

preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI
definition_of_done: Product code compiles with go build ./...

steps.symbol: new: Repo, World, Round, List, Get, CurrentRound, Game
steps.action: Create package world with Repo{Root, ContentDir string}; World{ID, Title string} yaml-decoded from <Root>/worlds/<id>/world.yaml (fields id, title); Round{ID string; Number int; Status string; StartsAt, EndsAt time.Time} yaml-decoded from rounds/*/round.yaml (id, number, status, starts_at, ends_at). List reads dirs under worlds; Get and CurrentRound call safepath.Segment first and return ErrNotFound for a missing world; CurrentRound picks highest Number; Game reads <ContentDir>/worlds/<id>/world.yaml and scenes/*.yaml into map[string]any and returns {world, scenes}.
steps.expected: Repo returns typed data or ErrNotFound

steps.symbol: new: Handler, List, Get, Game, CurrentRound
steps.action: Create Handler{Repo *Repo} with methods List, Get, Game, CurrentRound reading chi.URLParam(r,"id"), writing JSON with Content-Type application/json, 404 on ErrNotFound and 500 otherwise.
